project.description: ByteSky Node.js build job managed automatically by the Docker marketplace.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: set -e PROJECT_DIR="/workspace/bytesky-cloud" if [ ! -d "/workspace/bytesky-cloud" ]; then echo "Project directory not found: /workspace/bytesky-cloud" exit 1 fi cd "/workspace/bytesky-cloud" npm install npm --prefix backend install if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker build -t bytesky-cloud-app . else echo "Docker CLI is not available inside Jenkins, skipping docker build." fi
